nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender at construction and updatable by transferOwnership.
Emergency-stop flag controlling whenNotPaused/whenPaused gating of functions.
External EtherDungeon core contract interface used for hero details and power lookups.
Constant level 4 that refunds half of the entrance fee.
Constant level 8 that refunds the second half of the entrance fee.
Constant level 12 that lets the player win half the jackpot.
Constant difficulty (3) used when querying hero power.
Base monster health per level (10).
Additional damage dealt when a monster flees (4).
Time (8 minutes) after which a monster flees and damages the hero.
Fee (0.04 ether) required to start a dungeon run; owner-modifiable.
Accumulated prize pool, started at 0.1 ether, increased by lost fees and halved on jackpot wins.
Pool holding entrance fees pending refund or transfer to the jackpot.
Private PRNG seed mutated in _getRandomNumber.
Mapping of hero ID to the current Monster struct of its run.
Mapping of hero ID to its current health during a run.
Mapping of hero ID to the fee already refunded for that run.
Ownable constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
Owner-only function transferring ownership to newOwner after zero-address check.
Owner-only function setting paused = true.
Owner-only function setting paused = false.
Owner-only function calling selfdestruct(owner).
Owner-only function calling selfdestruct(_recipient).
View function returning all DungeonRunBeta game settings constants.
View function computing run state using now and edCoreContract hero data.
Payable external entry point: validates ownership, collects entrance fee, refunds excess ether, and calls _attack.
Owner-only setter for the edCoreContract address.
Owner-only setter for the entranceFee.
Internal combat resolution: computes damage, mutates monster/hero state, pays rewards and emits LogAttack.
Private PRNG returning _seed % _upper after rehashing block data.
Modifier rejecting callers with nonzero extcodesize (contracts).
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and ether transfers.
now, used for monster flee timing and game-state transitions (miner-influenceable).
selfdestruct(owner) permanently destroys the contract in destroy().
selfdestruct(_recipient) permanently destroys the contract in destroyAndSend().
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value - entranceFee) refunding excess ether sent to attack().
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value) refunding ether for non-initial attacks.
msg.sender.transfer(rewards) paying level rewards inside _attack.
Arithmetic updates to entranceFeePool and jackpot (add/subtract entrance fee shares).
damageByHero = (strength*1e9 + power*1e9/(10*rand)) / tx.gasprice, gas-price dependent and overflow-prone arithmetic.
monster.health -= uint8(damageByHero) unchecked narrowing/underflow arithmetic.
heroIdToHealth[_heroId] -= damageByMonster unchecked subtraction.
Weak PRNG: _seed = keccak256(_seed, blockhash, coinbase, difficulty) and _seed % _upper.
Comparisons of now against monster.creationTime + monsterFleeTime controlling damage and run termination.

_recipient parameter of destroyAndSend.

genes returned by edCoreContract.getHeroDetails in attack.

heroInitialHealth decoded from genes in attack.
heroStrength decoded from genes in attack.

heroCurrentHealth read from heroIdToHealth in attack.
Flag determining whether the run ended due to flee/timeout in attack.
addToJackpot computed from entranceFee minus refunded fee in attack.
Monster struct copy loaded from heroIdToMonster in attack.
heroPower returned by edCoreContract.getHeroPower in _attack.
Damage dealt by the monster or its flee attack in _attack.
Damage dealt by the hero, derived from gas price and PRNG in _attack.
addToJackpot computed when the hero is defeated in _attack.
Flag indicating the monster health dropped to zero in _attack.
Refund/jackpot rewards paid out in _attack.
newLevel of the next monster created in _attack.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter exists only to be validated and stored by transferOwnership.
_recipient is used solely as the selfdestruct beneficiary inside destroyAndSend.
_heroId is the sole input index used by attack for hero lookup.
_newEdCoreContract is only used to overwrite the edCoreContract state variable.
_newEntranceFee is only used to overwrite the entranceFee state variable.
_heroId parameter is consumed only by the internal _attack routine.
_genes parameter feeds the hero power query inside _attack.
_heroStrength parameter feeds the damage arithmetic inside _attack.
_heroCurrentHealth parameter is compared against monster damage inside _attack.
_upper only bounds the modulo in _getRandomNumber.
genes is a transient decode of getHeroDetails output inside attack.
owner local supports the msg.sender ownership require in attack.
heroInitialHealth is computed and stored only within attack.
heroStrength is derived in attack and forwarded to _attack.
currentLevel is read and branched on only inside attack.
heroCurrentHealth is a transient health snapshot used by attack.
dungeonRunEnded controls attack's internal branching and jackpot update.
addToJackpot in attack is the operand of the jackpot/pool arithmetic.
monster is a working copy of heroIdToMonster used only inside attack.
heroPower is a transient result of getHeroPower consumed by _attack.
damageByMonster is the subtrahend in the heroIdToHealth subtraction.
damageByHero is the result of the gas-price and PRNG arithmetic.
addToJackpot is recomputed and applied within _attack on hero defeat.
isMonsterDefeated is a branch selector local to _attack.
rewards is the exact value passed to msg.sender.transfer in _attack.
newLevel is used only to instantiate the next Monster inside _attack.
